correctness.rationale: The unique decomposition into shared edges, one alternating path and alternating cycles, together with a proved flip-distance metric, gives a bijective labeled-species enumeration. The component weights, exponential generating function, and extremal antipode formulas have been verified algebraically and by independent BFS and component-recurrence programs. Boundary k=1 is covered.
